display.purpose: Hero headline in Cormorant Garamond, italic phrase highlighted.

headline.purpose: Section headings, italic for the phrase that matters.

label.purpose: Table headers, card fields, captions, tooth numbers.

motion.name: word-rise
motion.value: translateY(112%) rotate(5deg) to none, 1.1s, 55ms per word

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one booking action: yellow pill with an ink circle holding the arrow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .85rem; min-height: 56px; padding: .5rem .5rem .5rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffcc29; color: #12203b; font: 700 1rem/1.2 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .3s, transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #12203b; color: #ffcc29; transition: transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffd651; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-icon { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #12203b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Secondary actions such as the SouSmile pre-evaluation.
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; padding-bottom: .2rem; color: #12203b; font: 700 1rem Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) 0 100% / 0% 1.5px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#b4c0d2, #b4c0d2) 0 100% / 100% 1.5px no-repeat; transition: background-size .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-link:hover { background-size: 100% 1.5px, 100% 1.5px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #12203b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Carimbo
components.description: The credentials as a round dentist stamp (see index.html for the full SVG with text on a circular path).
components.css: .ds-stamp { width: 172px; color: #1d3a7a; transform: rotate(-10deg); mix-blend-mode: multiply; }

components.css: .ds-appt { max-width: 400px; padding: 1.75rem; background: #fff; border-radius: 32px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(18,32,59,.12), 0 2px 4px rgba(18,32,59,.06), 0 22px 40px -20px rgba(18,32,59,.38); font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #12203b; } .ds-appt-title { margin: 0; padding-bottom: 1rem; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #12203b; font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif; font-size: 1.85rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-appt dl { margin: 0; } .ds-appt dl div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8rem 1fr; gap: 1rem; padding: .85rem 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed #b4c0d2; } .ds-appt dt { font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #5f6b84; } .ds-appt dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; } .ds-blank { color: #5f6b84; }

narrative.overview: The specialist clinical record filled in for the visitor, drawn with soft edges: arch photo, rounded sheets, pills, anatomic teeth and a round carimbo, in Cormorant Garamond and Manrope with the uniform navy and the smile yellow.
keyCharacteristics: Cormorant Garamond headings with italic emphasis, Manrope text
Yellow only for what matters now
One dark room that opens to full width

rules.name: One yellow
rules.body: Yellow marks the line that matters, the primary button or a live state. It never decorates.

rules.name: No kickers
rules.body: Headings stand alone; labels belong to form fields.

rules.name: One dark room
rules.body: Only the aligner/3D section is dark.

dos: Do write in Dra. Samanta's first person.
Do keep one primary label: Agendar avaliação.
donts: Don't add eyebrows, section numbers or cream backgrounds.
Don't invent testimonials, prices or contact data.
